item.title: 🍁🌿 Fall Hike: East Don Trail Adventure 🍪🥾 — Sat Nov 28, 11:00 AM
item.description:
Toronto Movies & Social Group - Celebrating 15 Years! # **Toronto’s Newest Ravine Trail, Autumn Scenery & Fresh-Baked Cookies!**
Did you join us for our last East Don Trail adventure? People had such a great time, and there was plenty to talk about afterward! Now that fall is here, we’re heading back to enjoy the trail in autumn. Join us as we explore the **East Don Trail**, one of Toronto’s newest additions to its incredible ravine system.
This beautiful route follows the East Don River through peaceful forests, wetlands, and scenic valley landscapes, connecting communities that were once separated. If you’ve walked the Lower Don Trail, this is a different experience.
Expect quieter pathways, river views, new bridges, and the feeling of discovering another corner of Toronto that many people have yet to explore.
Most of the route is paved and relatively easy to walk. Just one warning: what goes down must come up! 😄

item.title: New billing and capacity tools in Microsoft Fabric — Wed Dec 2, 1:00 PM
item.description:
Microsoft Reactor Toronto Join our product experts for an interactive Q&A session on managing and monitoring Microsoft Fabric capacities.
Managing Fabric at scale requires the right visibility, controls, and tools to keep workloads running smoothly.
In this session, we'll explore the latest capabilities for capacity management, optimization, and observability. We'll cover new billing tools in Fabric, how to monitor capacity health, optimize performance and cost, reduce throttling, investigate and resolve issues faster, and keep workloads predictable and reliable across your organization.
Bring your questions and get practical guidance on monitoring, managing, and optimizing your Fabric environment.
📌 This session is a part of a series! Learn more [here](https://developer.microsoft.com/reactor/series/S-1448/?wt.mc_id=meetup_27262_webpage_reactor)

The performance features artists of the Canadian Opera Company Ensemble Studio in excerpts of the opera. The story centres on the character of Joan, a tenacious woman who seeks to rescue her husband from the grips of the rougarou, a werewolf-like creature often described in stories passed down over generations.
